title: Multi-epoch Growth Rate Test of EFC Perturbation-Sector Coupling: f σ8(z) from BOSS DR12, eBOSS DR16, and DESI DR1
description: First multi-epoch empirical test of the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) perturbation-sector coupling using 14 fσ8(z) measurements from 6dFGS, BOSS DR12, eBOSS DR16, and DESI DR1. The study solves the full linear growth ODE with a regime-dependent gate μ(a)=1−B·T(a) and finds a null result: ΛCDM fits slightly better than EFC while EFC remains consistent within current errors, highlighting a strong Ωm–B degeneracy that requires BAO to break.
author: Morten Magnusson

growth_ode.description: Linear growth ODE for matter perturbations with an effective gravitational coupling μ(a); primes denote derivatives with respect to scale factor a.

mu_of_a.description: EFC perturbation-sector modification parameterized by amplitude B and a gate function T(a); ΛCDM corresponds to B=0.

gate_function.description: Regime-dependent gate controlling when the modification turns on; n is fixed to 2 as in the WP1a reference.

background.description: Flat ΛCDM background expansion used in the growth calculation.

growth_rate.description: Definition of the logarithmic growth rate f(a) in terms of the growth factor D(a).

fsigma8.description: Observable combination compared to RSD and PV measurements across redshift.

key_results.main_finding: ΛCDM provides an excellent fit and is marginally preferred over EFC, while EFC with μ0 in the survival valley remains fully consistent with current fσ8(z) data.

sealed_predictions.statement: A joint BAO + full-shape + RSD analysis with DESI DR2/DR3 (Ωm free) will localize μ0 within the EFC survival valley 0.93–0.96 if the EFC perturbation-sector coupling is correct.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: DESI DR2/DR3 BAO+RSD joint likelihood constraints on (μ0, Ωm, B, z_t) showing μ0 outside 0.93–0.96 at ≥2σ.

sealed_predictions.statement: Including BAO to break the Ωm–B degeneracy will prefer a late-time activation z_t ≳ 1 for any viable B > 0 solution.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Combined BAO+RSD profile likelihood for z_t peaking at z_t < 0.5 with B > 0 at ≥2σ.

kill_criteria: KC1: A combined BAO+RSD+PV analysis with full covariance and Ωm free constrains μ0 outside the survival valley [0.93, 0.96] at ≥3σ.
KC2: High-precision DESI DR2+/Stage-IV growth measurements exclude B > 0 at ≥3σ (i.e., favor B ≤ 0), implying μ(a) ≥ 1 and ruling out the required EFC growth suppression.
KC3: Tomographic fσ8(z) with ≤2% total uncertainty across 0.1 ≤ z ≤ 1.0 is consistent with ΛCDM such that any μ0 ∈ [0.93, 0.96] is excluded at ≥3σ over the range.

KC4: A global BAO+SN+CMB-distance+RSD fit shows that all EFC solutions keeping μ0 in [0.93, 0.96] require Ωm values inconsistent with background geometry at ≥3σ (e.g., Ωm > 0.40), indicating internal inconsistency of the EFC gate model.

related_packages.role: Code and data to reproduce the multi-epoch growth fits (EFC vs ΛCDM).

main_result.verdict: EFC consistent but not preferred; B=0 within 1σ profile

key_findings: Null result for growth sector: fσ8 data alone do not require modified mu(a)
Survival valley μ0 ∈ [0.93, 0.96] lies within the 1σ profile contour
Strong Ωm–B degeneracy: with Ωm free, optimizer drifts to Ωm≈0.45, B≈0.48
Cross-probe combination with BAO required to break degeneracy
